overview: ORLA’s interconnected buildings bring a range of residence sizes to the Palm Jumeirah crescent. Foster + Partners designed the architecture, while the dedicated site names YODEZEEN for interiors and ZED Collective for landscaping.
Dorchester Collection is the named residential manager. The precise standard services, optional extras and access rights should be confirmed for the chosen home.
research.locationNote: Palm Jumeirah, West Crescent. ORLA and ORLA Infinity are separately named developments; shared leisure access does not make their unit schedules interchangeable.
research.priceNote: Property Finder quotes AED 24m at launch and marks developer stock sold out while showing resale listings. This is historical guidance, not a current available-unit quotation. The reviewed primary pages do not publish a sale price.
research.paymentNote: Current own microsite: 5% booking, 20% SPA, 15% after 3 months, 10% after 6 months and 50% completion. Earlier factsheet: 10% at 12 months and 15% at 24 months. Confirm the applicable SPA; schedules are not interchangeable.
research.handoverNote: Current main OMNIYAT page says 2027. Its dedicated ORLA microsite still says 2026; Property Finder gives Q4 2026. Both primary versions remain live. A contractual date and actual handover status need confirmation.
